moa.t: Full μ-opioid agonist with NMDA antagonism, long, variable half-life

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Methadone, oral, 5–10 mg. · If symptoms are still present after 2–-4 hours, give another 5–10 mg. · Repeat until objective withdrawal symptoms are adequately managed

adjustments.t: Used in opioid dependence in pregnancy under specialist care; neonatal abstinence

cautions.t: Enzyme inducers (rifampicin, efavirenz) lower levels and may precipitate withdrawal

adverse_effects.t: Sedation, respiratory depression, constipation, QT prolongation, sweating

monitoring.t: ECG at higher doses, sedation score
